senses.gloss:
† कब् कब्, or कव् कव्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To colour.
 2. To praise.

कबन्ध कबन्ध, and कवन्ध क-वन्ध, [] m. and n.
 1. A headless trunk, especially one retaining the power of action, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 166.
 2. A belly, MBh. 3, 806.
 3. A cloud, or vapour, MBh. 3, 13087.
 4. The name of a demon, Rām. 3, 75, 24, sqq.
 --Cf. Κάανθος.
